title: status arguments
description: Report deskhand's state. A pure read: it changes nothing and never posts input. Optionally report whether a named holder holds the lease, and look up one operation record.

holder_id.description: Report the lease as seen from this holder. Without it the result's lease is null.

operation.description: Look up the record of one effect call. Nothing is executed and nothing is posted. The result's operation member is the record, or null when there is none.
